- Drive the architecture, design, and implementation of complex solutions that meet business goals and corporate strategic intent.
- Coordinate global resources and collaborate with cross-functional teams including product owners, architects, DevOps, and QA to ensure successful delivery of software projects.

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred.
- 15+ years of enterprise application development experience with a focus on Java technologies in high-revenue organizations.
- Extensive experience with large-scale modernization or greenfield SaaS projects.
- Proven track record of leading technical teams and delivering complex software solutions on time and within scope.
- Experience managing a broad portfolio of applications and coordinating global development resources.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

Required Skills

- Expert-level proficiency in Java, including deep hands-on experience with Java 21 features such as streams, functional programming, asynchronous programming with Futures, Virtual Threads, and CompletableFutures.

- In-depth knowledge of Java microservice architecture and event-driven design principles.
- Skilled in API development (both publisher and consumer) with strong emphasis on code quality and system documentation.
- Solid understanding of software development best practices (SDLC, Git version control).
- Experience deploying and managing applications in cloud environments, preferably Google Cloud Platform.
- Strong familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and Kanban processes.

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform services such as Google Pub/Sub and Kafka.
- Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines and Jira for agile project management.
- Additional knowledge of MongoDB and cloud-native CI/CD pipelines.

Appnovation is the AI Product Company. Headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, with teams around the world, Appnovation builds AI products, delivers enterprise AI and digital solutions, and co-invests with clients to bring new AI products to market.

Open source has been the foundation of Appnovation's work since 2007, and it remains the foundation underneath every AI product the company builds today. Appnovation teams work with organizations in highly regulated industries, including global leaders such as Pfizer, Google and AstraZeneca, to help them adopt AI they can govern and own.

We are building a modern, high-performance web product that seamlessly integrates cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence to deliver intelligent, real-time user experiences. We value practical, shipping-oriented engineers over fancy titles—people who love building clean, responsive front ends backed by fast, scalable backends.

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer with a strong foundation in modern web development and hands-on experience integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI workflows into production web applications.

- Build End-to-End Applications: Design, build, and maintain features across the entire stack, from reactive user interfaces to scalable backend microservices.

- Integrate AI Capabilities: Connect web backends with AI models, external APIs, vector databases, and real-time streaming services to power intelligent product features.

- Craft Real-Time Interfaces: Build rich, responsive UI components that support real-time data streaming (Server-Sent Events / WebSockets) and low-latency interactions.

- Optimize Performance & Reliability: Manage database schemas, caching, state management, and backend logic to keep the application fast, secure, and resilient.

- Collaborate & Deploy: Write clean, modular code with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure deployments.

- Strong proficiency in modern React frameworks (React, Next.js, or Vue.js) using TypeScript, HTML5, and modern CSS/Tailwind.

- Solid experience with Node.js/TypeScript (Next.js API routes, Express, Fastify) or Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask) or Java (Spring Boot)

- Practical experience integrating AI/LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, or hosting services) into web applications.

- Hands-on knowledge of tools and frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Vercel AI SDK.

- Familiarity with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, pgvector) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts.

- Basic DevOps/Cloud knowledge: Docker, CI/CD, and hosting on platforms like Vercel, AWS, or GCP.

- Personal side projects or open-source contributions showcasing full-stack web applications with integrated AI/LLM features.

- Experience with web accessibility, UI design systems, or client-side performance optimization.

- Exposure to AI evaluation tools or LLM observability frameworks (e.g., Langfuse, Helicone).
